resources.string: FnLock on; Fn layer off while held
FnLock on; Fn layer off for next key
FnLock on; Fn + Escape to toggle
FnLock off; Fn + Escape to toggle

Tap Ctrl, Shift or Alt to latch for one key. Tap twice to lock; a third tap unlocks. You can also hold modifiers while typing. Caps affects letters only.

Tap Fn for one layer key, or hold it to chord. Fn + Esc toggles persistent FnLock; holding Fn temporarily reverses the locked layer. Esc by itself stays Escape. F1–F12 stay primary.

Fn + ←/→: Home/End · Fn + B/P: Break/Pause (Android shares one keycode) · Fn + S: SysRq · Fn + K: Scroll Lock · Fn + Tab: previous keyboard · Fn + Space: keyboard picker.

Win is unavailable through Chrome. Chrome may reserve F6, Ctrl + Tab and Ctrl + PgUp/PgDn. The full layout is designed for tablets. Slide off a key to stop repeat; its initial keystroke has already been sent.
